Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'cheaper'.

examples.trans: It is cheaper to find new people.

examples.text: Дешевле найти новых людей, чем платить этот штраф.

examples.trans: At the morning market, fresh vegetables always cost less.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must, should; owe').

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'рого'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Каждый день = every day. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('every, each').
